title: Talk it through 3.3
role: Cultural guide helping a visitor who has made a social mistake
can_do: I can express regret and embarrassment.
I can give advice to avoid a cultural mistake with a light second conditional.

nodes.partner_line: I touched the sacred statue and everyone looked at me. I feel so embarrassed.
nodes.translation: Toqué la estatua sagrada y todos me miraron. Me siento muy avergonzado.

options.text: Don't worry. Many visitors make that mistake.
I understand. It was an honest mistake.
It's fine. Just say sorry to the guard.

nodes.model_reply: You should apologize and explain that you didn't know.

nodes.partner_line: If I had known the custom, I wouldn't have done it.
nodes.translation: Si hubiera sabido la costumbre, no lo habría hecho.

options.text: That's true. Next time you could ask the guide first.
Yes, it's better to ask than to guess.
Don't be too hard on yourself.

nodes.partner_line: How should I greet the elders in the village?
nodes.translation: ¿Cómo debería saludar a los mayores del pueblo?

options.text: You should shake hands softly and smile.
It's polite to nod and say good morning.
You ought to wait for them to greet you first.

nodes.partner_line: Is it rude to take photos of people?
nodes.translation: ¿Es grosero tomar fotos de las personas?

options.text: It can be, so you should ask for permission first.
Yes, in many places it is better to ask.
Not always, but it's polite to ask.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you. I will be more careful.

options.text: I'm sure you will do well.
Respect goes a long way. Enjoy the festival.
